references.text: Psalm 22 describes suffering that can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' sufferings on the cross, including the reactions of the crowds.
Micah 7:14 can be viewed in light of the people's expectation of a savior, such as their question about whether Elijah would come.
Isaiah 53 describes the suffering servant, whom Christians have traditionally interpreted as a prediction of Jesus' suffering and death.
In Matthew 17:10-13, it is discussed how Elijah has already come in the person of John the Baptist, which relates to the expectation of Elijah's arrival.
